import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import SpectralClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 3

def design(feats):
    # Identify potential drivers using t-statistics
    t_stats = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'clinical':
            continue
        y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
        y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
        t, _ = stats.ttest_ind(y0, y1, equal_var=False)
        t_stats.append((abs(t), fid))
    
    # Sort by absolute t-statistic
    t_stats.sort(reverse=True)
    
    # Select top features
    candidates = [fid for _, fid in t_stats[:20]]
    
    # Check for correlated pairs and remove near-duplicates
    corr_pairs = []
    for i in range(len(candidates)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(candidates)):
            fid1, fid2 = candidates[i], candidates[j]
            col1, col2 = feats.column(fid1), feats.column(fid2)
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0, 1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                corr_pairs.append((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Remove one from each correlated pair
    to_remove = set()
    for fid1, fid2 in corr_pairs:
        if fid1 in to_remove or fid2 in to_remove:
            continue
        # Prefer the one with lower t-statistic
        t1 = None
        t2 = None
        for t, f in t_stats:
            if f == fid1:
                t1 = t
            elif f == fid2:
                t2 = t
        if t1 is not None and t2 is not None and t1 < t2:
            to_remove.add(fid1)
        elif t1 is not None and t2 is not None:
            to_remove.add(fid2)
    
    # Build final driver set
    drivers = [fid for fid in candidates if fid not in to_remove][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    
    # If no clear mechanism, return empty drivers
    if not drivers:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build weighted score from drivers
    loadings = {}
    for fid in drivers:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, idx]
        y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, idx]
        diff = np.mean(y1) - np.mean(y0)
        loadings[fid] = diff
    
    # Normalize loadings
    total = sum(abs(w) for w in loadings.values())
    if total > 0:
        for fid in loadings:
            loadings[fid] /= total
    
    # Include all drivers in columns
    columns = tuple(drivers)
    
    # No products needed for this simple model
    products = ()
    
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
